reviews.assumption: Model-produced effect intent must not itself confer execution authority.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Typed intent text plus a named capability could accidentally become ambient authority at lowering/FFI boundaries.
reviews.falsifier: Any generated/FFI/subprocess path commits an effect without a host-held valid capability or equivalent external authority.
